explanation: The holdout has 10,000 customers, so 190,000 were treated. Each treated customer brought €41.20 - €40.00 = €1.20 extra, so the incremental revenue is €1.20 × 190,000 = €228,000, which is 228.0 thousand euros. Multiplying by all 200,000 customers, €240,000, wrongly counts the holdout, which got no campaigns.
